logger.doc:name: Start Log
logger.message: CorrelationId: #[vars.correlationId] OrderId:#[vars.orderId] Message: "Start Get order by id flow"

db:select.doc:name: Select Order
db:select.db:sql: SELECT ord.customer_id, ord.status, ord.total_amount, ord.currency, ord.created_at, ord.updated_at, it.quantity, it.unit_price, it.total_price, p.name, p.sku FROM orders ord INNER JOIN order_items it ON ord.id = it.order_id INNER JOIN products p ON it.product_id = p.id WHERE ord.order_number = :orderNumber

raise-error.doc:name: Raise CUSTOM:ORDER_NOT_FOUND error
raise-error.description: The requested Order is not found in the ERP System

logger.doc:name: End Log
logger.message: CorrelationId: #[vars.correlationId] OrderId: #[vars.orderId] Message: "End get order by id flow" Payload: #[payload]

ee:message.ee:set-payload: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- { code: 404, message: error.errorType.identifier, description: error.description, dateTime: now() as String {format: "yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss"}, correlationId: vars.correlationId }
